feeds.title: Traditional Bowhunter Magazine
feeds.description: Traditional Bowhunter Magazine addresses the needs of those who hunt with traditional archery equipment; however, its content holds appeal to all hunters with its strong ethical positions on wildlife, environment, and the management of our natural resources.

feeds.title: Toelke Traditional Archery
feeds.description: Toelke Traditional Archery, Is a custom Bow shop nestled along the rocky mountains of northwestern Montana. Here we strive to build the best traditional bows available! Read our Blogspot to learn more about traditional archery, what we have in stock, our products, and more.

feeds.title: Life and Longbows Blog
feeds.description: Hello and welcome to The Life and Longbows blog, dedicated to all things traditional archery with particular homage being paid to the author's all-time favorite type of bow the longbow. Here, you will find articles on traditional bowhunting, fly fishing, and all things stick and string.

feeds.title: Traditional Bowhunters of Montana
feeds.description: The Traditional Bowhunters of Montana is dedicated to the preservation and advancement of traditional bowhunting values in Montana. We promote high ethical standards for the hunting and taking of wild game by means of bow and arrow. The TBM provides fellowship to those who wish to pursue a traditional bowhunting lifestyle and is dedicated to continuing Montana's traditional bowhunting heritage.

feeds.title: Nebraska Traditional Archers
feeds.description: The Nebraska Traditional Archers welcome you to our website. Browse around to find out how to join, upcoming shoots and events, past newsletters, and lots of photos of our club members. The purpose of the Nebraska Traditional Archers is to promote responsible and ethical bowhunting practices and to support other archery organizations that do the same.

feeds.title: Twisted Stave Media
feeds.description: Twisted Stave Media is dedicated to the promotion of traditional archery, bow hunting, & bow building.

feeds.title: Simply Traditional
feeds.description: Simply Traditional focuses on hunting with Traditional Archery equipment. Our site offers articles, insights, reviews, and products to assist the traditional bowhunter in achieving their goal of harvesting animals with the stick and string.
